# Check the NMB matrix and strategy performance
nmb_matrix <- as.matrix(psa_obj$effect) * WTP - as.matrix(psa_obj$cost)
cat("NMB matrix summary:\n")
print(summary(nmb_matrix))

# Check which strategy is optimal in each simulation
optimal_strategies <- apply(nmb_matrix, 1, function(x) colnames(nmb_matrix)[which.max(x)])
cat("\nOptimal strategy distribution:\n")
print(table(optimal_strategies))

# Check expected NMB by strategy
expected_nmb <- colMeans(nmb_matrix)
cat("\nExpected NMB by strategy:\n")
print(expected_nmb)
cat("Optimal strategy:", names(expected_nmb)[which.max(expected_nmb)], "\n")

# Check if strategies are actually different
cat("\nCost differences between strategies:\n")
print(colMeans(as.matrix(psa_obj$cost)))
cat("\nEffect differences between strategies:\n")
print(colMeans(as.matrix(psa_obj$effect)))
